description: This PHP class implements the DMax function, which calculates the maximum value in a filtered database column based on specified criteria, mimicking an Excel database function.

classes.name: DMax
classes.description: A class that provides a static method to compute the maximum value in a database column subject to criteria, simulating Excel's DMAX function.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the maximum value in a database column that matches specified criteria, returning an error or null if the field is invalid.
